metrics.name: Active Company Count
metrics.gotcha: activityStatus is an OBJECT — NOT a string. Use activityStatus.activeFlag (BOOLEAN) for boolean filter. Alternatively: activityStatus.name == 'Active Customer'.

metrics.name: Managed Company Count
metrics.gotcha: Companies[] fields confirmed: id (UUID string), name (string), friendlyName (string), activityStatus (OBJECT with id/name/activeFlag/defaultFlag), ownershipType (OBJECT with id/name), SitesCount (integer), DevicesCount (integer), lifeCycleState (string).

metrics.name: Company Roster
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Companies[].{id: id, name: name, friendlyName: friendlyName, activityStatus: activityStatus.name, ownershipType: ownershipType.name, sitesCount: SitesCount, devicesCount: DevicesCount}
metrics.gotcha: activityStatus.name and ownershipType.name extract the string label from their respective OBJECT fields. Both activityStatus and ownershipType are objects, not strings.

metrics.name: Discovered Child System Count
metrics.gotcha: Discovered[] fields confirmed: EnvironmentSearch (string — company short-name), Alias (string — friendly name for the child launchpoint), Inspector (string — inspector slug), Parent (integer — parent launchpoint ID), Config (object with COMPANY_ID).

metrics.name: Discovered Children
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Discovered[].{EnvironmentSearch: EnvironmentSearch, Alias: Alias, Inspector: Inspector}
metrics.gotcha: Discovered[0] confirmed fields: EnvironmentSearch, Alias, Inspector (all strings). Additional fields in the raw object: Parent (integer), Config (object with COMPANY_ID key).

metrics.name: Companies With Zero Devices
metrics.gotcha: DevicesCount is INTEGER — use backtick-quoted literal `0`. Confirmed integer on Companies[0].DevicesCount.

metrics.name: Total Computer Count
metrics.gotcha: Computers[] is the only device data array in this dataprint. Fields include: ComputerID, ComputerName, DomainName, LocationId, LocationName, ClientId, ClientName, OperatingSystecAame (API typo — misspelled), OperatingSystemVersion, SerialNumber, LocalIPAddress, MACAddress, RemoteAgentLastContact, DaysSinceRemoteAgentLastContact_r, LastUserName.

metrics.name: Desktop Antivirus Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: AntivirusSummaryDesktops.{Updated: Updated, Outdated: Outdated, NotInstalled: NotInstalled, InformationUnavailable: InformationUnavailable}

metrics.name: Server Antivirus Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: AntivirusSummaryServers.{Updated: Updated, Outdated: Outdated, NotInstalled: NotInstalled, InformationUnavailable: InformationUnavailable}
metrics.gotcha: AntivirusSummaryServers confirmed fields: Updated (integer), Outdated (integer), NotInstalled (integer), InformationUnavailable (integer). All 4 fields exist — previous PROPOSED path only included 3.

metrics.name: Device Inventory (Last Known State)
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Devices[].{machineID: machineID, machineName: machineName, assetType: assetType, companyName: companyName, siteName: siteName, operatingSystem: operatingSystem, online: online, lastSeenOnline: lastSeenOnline, lastReboot: lastReboot}
metrics.gotcha: Devices[] confirmed fields: machineID, machineName, friendlyName, hostName, assetType, companyId, companyName, siteId, siteName, operatingSystem, lastSeenOnline, lastReboot, ipAddresses, macAddresses, cpu, memoryTotal, etc. NOTE: 'online' field is not present in older EOL-era dataprints — the projection returns null for that key.

metrics.name: Health Score Summary
metrics.gotcha: SummaryScore.Scores confirmed fields: DesktopAntivirus, DesktopDiskSpace, DesktopPatch, DesktopTempFile, DesktopWarranty, Overall, ServerAntivirus, ServerAvailability, ServerCpuUtilization, ServerDiskUtilization, ServerMemoryUtilization, ServerPatch, ServerWarranty — all integers. Value -1 = data unavailable for that category.

metrics.name: Server Patch State Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: PatchesStateServers.{Installed: Installed, Missing: Missing, Blacklisted: Blacklisted, MarkedForDeployment: MarkedForDeployment, Others: Others, UnderReview: UnderReview}
metrics.gotcha: PatchesStateServers confirmed fields: Blacklisted, Installed, MarkedForDeployment, Missing, Others, UnderReview — all integers.

metrics.name: Site Statistics Summary
metrics.gotcha: SummarySite confirmed fields (all integers unless noted): AntivirusMachineCount, AntivirusMachineUpdated, DesktopCount, FirewallCount, MobileDeviceCount, PatchesInstalled, PatchesUnderReview, ServerCount, ServiceTicketsClosed, ServiceTicketsOpened, SwitchCount, ThirdPartyPatchesInstalled. NOTE: TemporaryFilesRemoved is a STRING (e.g. '0'), not an integer.

metrics.name: Server Warranty Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: WarrantySummaryServers.{Active: Active, Expired: Expired, DataUnavailable: DataUnavailable, Error: Error}
metrics.gotcha: WarrantySummaryServers confirmed fields: Active (integer), Expired (integer), DataUnavailable (integer), Error (null — not an integer). Error field returns null when no warranty lookup error occurred.

metrics.name: Open Alert Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. There is no Alerts[] array on any dataprint shape, so alert severity, age and policy name are not available.

metrics.name: Online Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. Devices[].offline is a boolean (false = online); use the backtick-quoted literal.

metrics.name: Total Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only; a parent dataprint has no Devices key. Matches the asset-inventory count of devices whose inspectors[] contains ninja-rmm-inspector.

metrics.name: Pending Patch Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only (the parent holds the tenant roster). Works on lean and expanded shapes because it reads the per-device DeviceHealth_r rollup, not PatchStatus[].

metrics.name: Technician MFA Enabled Count
metrics.gotcha: Parent system only. mfaConfigured is a boolean; use the backtick-quoted literal.

metrics.name: Technician Count
metrics.gotcha: Parent system only. Child dataprints also have a Users[] array, but it holds END_USER contacts (or is empty), so length(Users) on a child is not a technician count.
